observed_behavior: Before N-0086: the Next same-origin proxy copied every incoming header except hop-by-hop, so a visitor-supplied X-Forwarded-For reached the API; Next 15 fills X-Forwarded-For only when the client sent none; the API login throttle keyed on the right-most X-Forwarded-For entry from a loopback peer, so the per-address limit could be dodged by rotating the header. Every write on /imports (except admin bulk delete and PM import), /cst-steward, /mappings, /product-master-gaps and /exceptions required only sign-in (route table before). Web hides Data & Stewardship nav for planner/viewer but the pages themselves had no role gating.
